project.title: Corrections and resource bounds for the Trotter quantum transport algorithm
project.summary: We audit arXiv:2508.15691v2 and the published Quantum Science and Technology article *Trotter-based quantum algorithm for solving transport equations with exponentially fewer time-steps* by Zylberman, Fredon, Loureiro and Debbasch. Ten registered correction groups persist in the directly inspected journal PDF. Exact counterexamples refute conservation of spatial derivative norms for variable transport fields and the signed-overlap identity assigned to a controlled-SWAP circuit. Further corrections concern transport and Liouville signs, Fourier inversion, moment normalization, constants and index ranges. We retain finite-time regularity factors and apply established commutator reasoning to obtain a coefficient-aware finite-grid operator bound proportional to inverse mesh spacing rather than its square for smooth periodic coefficients. This sharpens the chosen comparison baseline without proving a complete repaired vector-norm theorem or disproving the usefulness of smooth-state analysis. Independent calculations reproduce the reported eight-point discretization errors and a separate periodic splitting diagnostic. A version concordance, attributed source statements and numerical provenance tables make the findings directly checkable. The journal's added Gaussian-width, circuit-cost and boundary qualifications are acknowledged. No end-to-end quantum advantage, general impossibility result or inference about unavailable implementation code is claimed.
project.research_question: Which specified arXiv v2 and journal statements fail exact checks, which finite-time/resource qualifications are needed, and which numerical observations survive?

claims.text: The audited v2 derivative-norm conservation assertion fails for a smooth periodic shear satisfying its coordinate-independence condition.
claims.evidence_summary: Exact shear solution and gradient identities in Section 4.1, independently sampled in reproduction/canonical/results/shear.csv.
claims.confidence_note: Applies to specified arXiv v2 and journal passages; not a complete journal error audit or a refutation of every finite-time smooth-state bound.

claims.text: Smooth periodic coefficients permit a finite-grid commutator bound proportional to inverse mesh spacing, improving the paper's crude inverse-square operator comparator.
claims.evidence_summary: Translation/multiplication commutator identity and numerical operator norms in Section 4.2 and reproduction/canonical/results/commutators.csv.
claims.confidence_note: Fixed dimension/order and bounded coefficient gradients; not an optimal end-to-end complexity theorem.

claims.text: The printed SWAP-test probabilities and polynomial-moment continuum prefactor disagree with direct finite-dimensional checks.
claims.evidence_summary: Controlled-SWAP matrix and normalized constant-function overlap checks in reproduction/canonical/results/swap.csv, reproduction/canonical/results/moments.csv and reproduction/canonical/results/resource-counterchecks.json.
claims.confidence_note: Does not invalidate the separate Hadamard protocol or identify the original code unavailable in the inspected arXiv materials.

claims.text: The reported eight-point hardware discretization-error magnitudes are reproduced, and a separate periodic smooth example exhibits a stable fixed-step splitting error under grid refinement.
claims.evidence_summary: reproduction/canonical/results/resource-counterchecks.json retains exact settings and reference-refinement differences.
claims.confidence_note: Deterministic classical calculations; no hardware rerun, original Figure 5 reproduction, repaired full theorem or demonstrated quantum advantage.

claims.text: All ten registered correction groups persist in the directly obtained published journal PDF, with the mathematical and implementation qualifications retained.
claims.evidence_summary: reproduction/canonical/data/journal-comparison.json binds C1–C10, each arXiv/journal locator, the official PDF URL and SHA-256 1b8f24ed2bcd4979526977581fc795f80d90a6efeacfbe28e65339cf8b4803e1. The full source-equation appendix remains in the manuscript.
claims.confidence_note: This checks the ten specified printed groups, not every new journal passage or original execution. Added Gaussian-width, simulation/readout-cost and boundary discussions are credited; local corrections have differing consequences. No fabrication, hardware rerun or original-figure failure is inferred.
